item.title: NHL: Vancouver Canucks +1.5 -130 at BetMGM (Medium, +9.7 pts)
item.description:
NHL · New York Rangers @ Vancouver Canucks · Fri Nov 13, 9:10 PM ET

Puck line: Vancouver Canucks +1.5 at -130 (BetMGM). Our probability 66.2% from game data, the price implies 56.5%, edge +9.7 pts, EV +17.1% per unit. Confidence: Medium.

Our probability at +1.5 is 66.2%, from the game data: this season's results and margins, recent form, rest, the injury report and home edge (projected margin -0.3 for the home side). BetMGM offers -130, which implies only 56.5%. Its bar is 6.3 points: the model's own margin of error on this side, with 20 games behind the thinner team (±0.44 goals on the margin). It clears it by 3.4. Not graded against other books' prices; for reference the market makes it 55.4%.

What supports it:

  • Home edge +0.2 for Vancouver Canucks.
  • Vancouver Canucks are rested (4 days).
  • New York Rangers without Alberts Smits (D), Sean Durzi (D), Igor Shesterkin (G) and 1 more (+0.3).

What could go wrong:

  • Vancouver Canucks rate -0.8 a game over 20 (3-17), New York Rangers +0 over 20 (11-9); last season -1.2 and -0.1 a game.
  • New York Rangers trending: last five +0.8 vs +0.2 on the season.
  • Vancouver Canucks without Filip Chytil (C) (-0.1).
  • Vancouver Canucks have Tom Willander (D) listed day-to-day or questionable.
  • Projected margin -0.3 for Vancouver Canucks against +1.5.

Verdict: More working against this one than for it; size down.

Prices: BetMGM -130, Caesars -132, DraftKings -135, theScore Bet -135, ESPN BET -135 and 2 more.
